name: Edit me: site configuration (On Start tab)
START HERE
info:
1) Open "Edit me: site configuration (On Start tab)", go to its **On Start** tab and set the charge window, battery cost and battery values.
2) Deploy. The configuration is applied on every deploy.
3) After checking the "Rules plan (per hour)" debug output, click "Set DESS mode = 4 (Node-RED)" once.

name: Timing
info:
Every hour (at :00): plan from the cached prices and write the changes to the GX (usually none).
From 15:00 (refreshFromHour) the same run fetches tomorrow's EnergyZero prices once, retrying every hour until they are published. Today's prices are fetched when the current hour has no price (e.g. after a restart).
"Force price refresh" refetches tomorrow's prices immediately.
Set the GX timezone to Europe/Amsterdam.

name: Build EnergyZero URL
Prices & cheapest hour
info:
Public EnergyZero endpoint, no API key. Uses priceProperty (default all_in_with_vat, consumer all-in price incl. VAT).
Stores all hourly prices (the response holds two days) and picks tomorrow's cheapest block of chargeHours consecutive hours (lowest average price, ties go to the earliest).
Charge windows are stored per date in flow context (cheapestHourDessTargets); ended windows are kept 48 h as price reference.
If prices are not available yet, the cached plan is used unchanged.

name: Find cheapest charge window (Europe/Amsterdam)
Rules
info:
One slot per hour, from now until the last known price:
- charge: inside the cheapest charge window -> TargetSoc = targetSoc, Strategy 2: charge from grid at up to tb_max.
- self-consume: price > charge price / roundTripEfficiency + b_cycle_cost -> Strategy 1 + no battery->grid: battery follows live consumption. TargetSoc = minSoc (ignored by the GX, only for the plan graph).
- hold: otherwise -> TargetSoc 100, Strategy 2 + no grid->battery: battery does not discharge, grid covers loads, solar may charge. The 100% is required: a lower target would make the GX discharge towards it.
Charge price = average price of the last charge window (before the first one: the upcoming window).

name: Map plan to dbus writes
Write to GX
info:
Writes the plan into the GX schedule slots (period % slots). Only changed values are sent; ended slots are left alone; unused slots are disabled with Duration=0. Everything is re-sent after deploy/restart and every 6 h (unchanged values are no-ops on the GX).
Also keeps /Settings/DynamicEss/BatteryCapacity (b_max), BatteryChargeLimit (tb_max) and BatteryDischargeLimit (fb_max) in line with the config.
The path is taken from msg.path; the node's own path is only a type template.

name: ONE-TIME after import
info:
Click "Set DESS mode = 4 (Node-RED)" once after importing and verifying a test run.
Use "Revert DESS mode = 1 (VRM Auto)" if you want to stop using this flow.
Do not leave mode 4 active if this flow is disabled.

name: Load cached cheapest hour
Store charge window
Rules planner
Schedule viewer
info:
Open http://<GX address>:<Node-RED port>/dess in a browser for a chart and table of the current plan.
/dess?format=json returns the same data as JSON.
Read-only: shows what the Rules planner stored in flow context (cheapestHourDessPlan); nothing is written to the GX.
If Node-RED has httpNodeRoot or httpNodeAuth set in settings.js, the URL/login follows those settings.
